P = 1000000007

def main():
    n = int(input())
    stride = n + 1
    table = [0] * (stride * stride)
    table[0] = 0

    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            index = i * stride + j
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                continue
            if i == 0:
                table[index] = (table[index - 1] + ((i + j) & 1)) % P
            else:
                table[index] = (table[index - stride] + table[index - 1] + ((i + j) & 1)) % P

    print(table[n * stride + n])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
